## About
We're an auto body shop on Silber Road in Houston. We handle collision repair and automotive painting for all makes and models, including imports.
Customers often mention Miguel by name. Reviewers say he walks them through the process, treats their car with care, and finds ways to get the job done on their budget.
We're rated 4.8 from 92 Google reviews. If you don't see what you need listed, just ask. We try to take on new requests.

## Services
- Auto body collision repair: Repair after an accident, from dings and dents to front-end damage, for all makes and models including imports.
- Automotive painting: Touch ups to a whole new look, for all makes and models.
- Towing: Call us and we can tow your car to the shop with our own tow service.

## FAQ
Q: Can my insurance company's tow service drop off my car?
A: Yes. Your insurance provider's tow service can drop your vehicle off inside our lot, which is open around the clock.

Q: What do I do if I drop my car off after hours?
A: Drop the keys in our mail slot by the front door with your contact information. We'll bring your car into the garage the next morning and call you with a repair quote. Please take the registration and any personal belongings with you.

Q: Do you work on imports?
A: Yes. We repair and paint all makes and models, including imports.
